criteria.reasoning: Headings and sections follow the required structure and the document is mostly readable. Presentation is weakened by a Wikipedia source, citations [49]–[74] absent from the bibliography, [10] used for two different sources, stray characters in references, a truncated sentence, unnumbered tables and figures, and a duplicated access number.
Requirement tracking is captured in the requirements array; no separate criterion mark.

technical_issues.issue: RAAN of 27.33° is described as indicating the launch facility location; RAAN is not set by launch site, and Kourou is near 53°W so the value is unjustified.
Kourou (about 5°N) to a 97.8° retrograde orbit is an unusual, costly launch case; the report does not address azimuth or performance penalties.
Claim that two launch windows per day occur because site latitude is smaller than inclination is loosely reasoned and not supported by calculation.
Vega E stated to first launch in 2024, yet the mission is planned for 2025 and the alternatives section is based on a 2021 calendar; timeline is inconsistent.
Altitude selection reasoning is contradictory: high altitude is said to give low resolution yet this is called desirable, and no swath or GSD calculation is shown.
Daily imaging of the whole reef is claimed at 600 km without a revisit or swath calculation; orbital period is not stated.
Only argument of latitude and five elements are given; the claim that Keplerian elements fully describe the orbit lacks epoch and state details.
At 600 km, uncontrolled decay is not quantified against the 25-year guideline; claim of burn-up on uncontrolled descent is unsupported. Passive EOL is not resolved.
States the only manoeuvre is at EOL, yet the EOL strategy is passive and undecided, so manoeuvre requirements are inconsistent.
Access table lists two entries numbered 13 and the text says fifteen periods, though numbering is inconsistent.

overall: A reasonably developed sun-synchronous design with STK evidence and a clear introduction. Major weaknesses include inconsistent launch timeline, incorrect RAAN rationale, an unresolved and unquantified EOL, a truncated drag-sail sentence, and widespread citation failures including Wikipedia and missing references.
